about: Native code the iOS app links that npm and autolinking can't account for:
React Native's prebuilt C++ dependencies (ReactNativeDependencies) and Hermes.
The prebuilt artifacts ship no licence files, so these texts were copied from
each project's own sources, as CocoaPods fetched them when React Native was last
built from source here (fast_float from its upstream LICENSE-MIT). scripts/licences.mts
merges them into the licences page. Revisit this list when React Native's major version
moves: the test beside src/features/credits/licences.json fails until you do.
